title.zh: 承认 Everest Academy 为具有国际性质的教育机构并给予该学院促进其发展的特定特权
title.en: An Act Recognizing the Everest Academy as an Educational Institution of International Character and Granting the Academy Certain Prerogatives to Promote Its Development
title.orig: An Act Recognizing the Everest Academy as an Educational Institution of International Character and Granting the Academy Certain Prerogatives to Promote Its Development

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11255_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Everest Academy, herein referred to as the "Academy", registered as Everest International Academy, is hereby declared and officially recognized as a basic educational institution of international character authorized to operate educational programs that primarily and principally adhere to universally accepted and recognized educational policies.
The Academy shall be governed by a board of trustees, herein referred to as the "Board", elected in accordance with its corporate character.

The Academy shall be under the supervision and regulation of the Department of Education (DepEd) and shall adhere to basic laws, and rules and regulations of the DepEd governing international or foreign schools.

Within sixty (60) days from the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education, in consultation with the members of the Board of the Everest Academy, shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
If any provision of this Act is held invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not so declared shall remain in force and effect.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
